findings.issue: Dependency label mismatch in Details section: 'Tasks 4 (db schema), 5 (drive.py), 6 (grader.py)' — but T4 is Google Drive integration, not db schema (T2 is db.py). The parenthetical labels are wrong even though the task numbers themselves are correct. An implementer reading only the Details section could be confused about what T4 provides.
findings.recommendation: Correct the Details dependency description to: 'Tasks 2 (db.py), 4 (drive.py), 5 (pdf_processor.py), 6 (grader.py) must be complete before this task starts.' Note: depends_on frontmatter currently lists [4, 5, 6] and omits T2 (db.py), which is also a required dependency used throughout the pipeline — consider adding it.

findings.issue: Integration test ambiguity: the TDD anchor and description both state test_full_pipeline_5_students uses 'real Drive', but the implementation hint says 'may mock Drive/LLM calls for speed, but test_full_pipeline_5_students uses real Drive.' It is silent on whether the LLM must also be real. The tech-spec testing strategy explicitly requires: 'Assert that the LLM was actually called (not mocked) by checking recognized_answer is populated from the real scan.' The task hint's wording leaves the LLM mockable even in the full pipeline test, which contradicts the tech-spec.
findings.recommendation: Update the implementation hint to: 'test_full_pipeline_5_students uses real Drive AND real LLM (no mocks). All other tests may mock Drive/LLM for speed.' This aligns with the tech-spec integration test requirement.

Stop flag checked between students (not within pipeline steps) — documented in edge cases.

Edit/Delete are rendered only for status=pending cohorts, and the edge cases section reinforces 'Edit/Delete buttons must check status at render time'. summary: Tasks 7, 8, 9 are realistic, adequately scoped, and internally consistent. Two warnings on T7: (1) the Details dependency labels mis-identify T4 as 'db schema' when T4 is Drive integration (T2 is db.py), and depends_on frontmatter omits T2 which is a real dependency; (2) the implementation hint is ambiguous about whether the LLM must be real in test_full_pipeline_5_students, contradicting the tech-spec requirement for a non-mocked integration test. All specific checks pass for all three tasks: T7 has request_stop(), daemon thread, sanitization, and resumability; T8 handles both file uploader and grid display and registers in app.py; T9 uses st.fragment(run_every=2), disables Start Processing when running, and blocks edit for non-pending cohorts.
